invariants: PlayerData and local preference/cache never establish paid ownership.
Entitlement unknown, loading, timeout, or failed restore is not owned and is not denial.
Loss of cosmetic access falls back to a free default without affecting collision, adjudication, or score.
Cosmetic rendering and remote cosmetic summaries never determine radius, abilities, queue priority, collision, or score.
Preference recovery must complete before defaults are persisted over prior user data.
No official API signature, product ID, or commerce callback contract is proposed here; defer to T34-T36.

states.meaning: Usable free baseline cosmetic; always available.

Optional cosmetic may be selected only after official confirmation.

No definitive authority result; keep free default and allow retry policy outside this proposal.
Official authority says unavailable; use free default.
Lookup timed out; do not treat timeout as ownership or revocation.
Lookup failed; keep free default and expose non-blocking status.
Official authority confirms access loss; immediately fall back to free default.
Connection/authority recovery pending; keep free default.
Awaiting local preference restore; do not overwrite prior data with defaults.
Preference data restored; validate schema and entitlement independently.
Recovery failed; use safe defaults in memory; do not claim old data is absent or overwrite it automatically.
